title: Human-approved single-agent provisional research and scoped update pilot
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's explicit request to implement the six-hour priority plan: scoped research updates, storage, public procurement evidence, AI workload evaluation, linked roadmaps and planning views, and validation. The user explicitly requires all new research to remain single-model/single-agent provisional, never Consensus-accepted. Preserve prior evidence and unconfirmed gaps. This does not enable unattended production, authorize procurement/adoption, access restricted specifications, or grant independent review status.
